# Free Fax Desk

> Free, open-source Windows fax app for small offices that have an internet fax line (Phone.com first). Incoming fax inbox, send PDFs with a cover page, send log, no telemetry. Free for one PC; whole-office (LAN) plan is $99 one time. Published by HnS, LLC.

- Home: https://freefaxdesk.com/
- Whole office plan: https://freefaxdesk.com/office
- Fax services with an API (comparison): https://freefaxdesk.com/providers
- Code signing policy: https://freefaxdesk.com/signing
- Source code and downloads (MIT): https://github.com/FreeFaxDesk/faxdesk
- Support: help@freefaxdesk.com

## Facts
- Windows 10/11, single EXE, no install; Python standard library only.
- Works with a Phone.com account's fax number via the Phone.com API; other providers planned (SRFax next).
- Nothing phones home: no analytics, no update checks, no cloud account.
- Not affiliated with Phone.com.
